title: Repository guidance
text: layers R API -> package-owned C glue -> vendored C libraries. R/parquet.R: eager /O user-facing helpers. R/parquet-file.R: open handles, inspection, selection, collection. R/parquet-plan.R: shared read mapping logical conversion. R/parquet-schema.R: writer schema inference overrides. src/qio.c: writer bridge native registration. src/qio_file.c: handles, metadata, collection, batches. src/{carquet,zstd,lz4}/: vendored libraries. Keep physical decoding C logical reinterpretation shared R read plan. qio_type_registry() owns physical fallbacks; qio_apply_plan() must keep read_parquet(), collect(), walk_batches() consistent. read_parquet() open_parquet() plus collect(). Open files external pointers finalizers. Native entry points must validate pointer respect open/busy guards; close must remain idempotent. Eager reads request mmap may decode numeric columns parallel. Persistent handles default buffered /O.

Preserve goal zero required runtime R dependencies unless recorded design decision says otherwise. Export document public functions. create roxygen topics internal helpers. Regenerate man/ NAMESPACE; never edit generated .Rd files. Wrap roxygen text 80 characters run air format . R sources. Renaming anything public means sweep whole repository, R/ tests/. bench/, tools/, README.md, AGENTS.md, .agents/ C comments name public functions result columns, none compiled tested, stale reference survives green suite clean R CMD check. tools/check-inspection--arrow.R one fails loudly; run rename. add NEWS.md entries 0.1.0 released. section one line, * Initial release., stays way: nothing 0.1.0 ever published, installed version change described . Record reasoning .agents/ behavior reference documentation instead. 0.1.0 ships, add short NEWS.md item every user-visible change. Never edit src/carquet place. qio vendors qio branch carquet fork, every local change commit top pinned upstream commit. Make change , push , re-copy, update fork pin .agents/VENDORED.md, also documents re-vendoring patch becomes upstream pull request. tools/check-vendor-drift.sh fails CI vendored file edited place, ledger disagrees series. rule applies src/zstd src/lz4: re-vendor rather patch. src/Makevars* declares vendored headers prerequisites, header change rebuilds every object ; tools/check-header-deps.sh proves . manual clean valid reset longer required. code: # qio's writer emits no bloom filters, so this uses a bundled file written # by pyarrow. Its `key` column runs 0..3999 across four row groups. path <- system.file("extdata", "bloom_sorted.parquet", package = "qio") pf <- open_parquet(path)  # Row group 1 holds keys 0..999. title: Inspect Parquet column chunks — column_chunks
text: data frame one row per column chunk, ordered row group column, columns: row_group 1-based row-group ID, row_groups() reports . column 1-based physical column index, schema() reports . path Complete dotted column path; see schema() identifier rather bare leaf name. physical_type Parquet physical type leaf. compression Codec name, "SNAPPY" "UNCOMPRESSED". Set per chunk, one file may mix codecs. num_values Values stored chunk, nulls included. compressed_bytes, uncompressed_bytes Size chunk disk decompression. Equal uncompressed chunk. encodings Encodings chunk declares, comma separated. dictionary-encoded chunk typically lists RLE_DICTIONARY alongside PLAIN dictionary page uses. dictionary_page Whether chunk dictionary page. bloom_filter Whether bloom filter present, bloom_filter_may_contain() needs. page_index Whether column index offset index present; page_index() reports either. Sizes counts doubles rather integers, chunk can exceed .Machine$integer.max.
